name: Appartements Alpenkristall
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The **Alpenkristall Apartments** are located in the village of **Söll** and offer a peaceful setting at the foot of the Kaisergebirge mountains. The directly connected **Gasthof** (guesthouse) features a dining area and beverage service. The accommodation units are designed as self-catering holiday apartments with a kitchenette, ideal for guests who prefer to prepare their own meals. The facilities include free Wi-Fi and parking directly at the house. The village center of **Söll** is just a few minutes’ walk away, along with shopping options and access to the **Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser** ski resort. Guests will find a well-equipped stay in traditional **Tiroler** style, perfect for a carefree holiday without meal requirements.
